source: vanilla 26.3 server jar, black-box via public API: GameTestServer level, connection-less ServerPlayer, ItemStack(minecraft:torch).useOn(UseOnContext(player, MAIN_HAND, BlockHitResult(face centre, face, clickedPos, false)))

grid.set_by: Entity.snapTo(x,y,z,yaw,pitch) then setYRot(yaw), setXRot(pitch), setYHeadRot(yaw), setYBodyRot(yaw)
grid.convention: vanilla Entity yRot/xRot in degrees. Measured (looks[].view = Entity.getViewVector(1), exact doubles, x=east y=up z=south): yaw 0 -> +z (south), 90 -> -x (west), 180 -> -z (north), 270 -> +x (east); pitch -90 -> +y (up), 0 -> level, +90 -> -y (down); view ~= (-sin(yaw)cos(pitch), -sin(pitch), cos(yaw)cos(pitch))

dir_letters: D=down U=up N=north(-z) S=south(+z) W=west(-x) E=east(+x)
cells: D=(96,150,96); clicked face F: case A clicks stone at D-offset(F) on face F (placement cell D); case B clicks short_grass at D on face F
cfg_legend: 5 chars B,N,S,W,E = stone at D.below, D.north, D.south, D.west, D.east ('-' = air). Case A: the clicked block's own cell is always stone, so only configs with that bit set are listed (face D: all 32, clicked block is above D). Case B: first char 'B' = grass_block below (always), short_grass at D, last 4 = stone on D's sides
r_format: one code per look, 312 chars, in look_index order
order_format: nearest = Direction.orderedByNearest(player); ctx[case+face] = BlockPlaceContext.getNearestLookingDirections() for that click, then 'p' (plain) or 'r' (replacingClickedOnBlock), then '@D' if getClickedPos()==D
